**Scope note**
Maspice targets macOS 26+ on Apple Silicon and connects directly to standard
QEMU or Ravada SPICE endpoints. Proxmox/PVE proxy transport, generic proxies,
USB redirection, automatic host-resource sharing, and Intel support are outside
the current product scope.
